title: Context and memory in the makerspace assistant

items.stem: On Monday a student tells the assistant, "I prefer mornings." Nothing is saved when the chat ends. On Tuesday the student opens a new chat and asks for a booking. What does the model know about the preference?

options.text: It still knows, because the model learned it during Monday's chat
It knows only if the program looks the preference up in storage
It does not know, because nothing in the new context mentions it
It knows, because the context window keeps old chats for a week

items.stem: An agent run has three model calls. The system prompt and tool descriptions are 1,000 tokens. Call 1 sees only those. The model writes a 40-token tool request, and the 500-token result is added, then call 2 runs. The model writes another 40-token request, and a 200-token result is added, then call 3 runs. Each call's input is everything so far. How many input tokens are billed across all three calls?
The assistant uses a search_manuals tool over 400 pages of manuals. Who compares the student's question with the manual chunks, and what does the model then see?

options.text: The program searches; the model sees only the few chunks returned
The model searches; it sees all 400 pages and picks the best one
The program searches; the model sees all 400 pages and the matches
The model searches; it sees only the few chunks it remembers

items.stem: Which fact is the best candidate to save as a note between sessions, so the assistant can load it for that student next time?

options.text: The full text of the student's whole chat from today's session
The exact tool results the calendar returned during today's session
The safety rules the assistant must follow in every conversation
That the student passed the laser cutter training on 12 October

items.stem: A teammate says, "Buy access to a model with a huge context window, and we can just put every manual in the prompt." Give one reason, in a sentence, why that is still a poor design for your budget.
